falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically saw immediate stabilization without new lows; a break below this level invalidates the structural bottom thesis and suggests the pattern match was coincidental noise, not predictive

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX compression as a defining characteristic; sustained elevated fear premium contradicts the behavioral signature of that pattern and indicates market stress inconsistent with a confirmed bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug occurred during a rates-stabilization regime; a sharp flight-to-quality rally in bonds would signal macro deterioration (recession scare or financial stress) that overrides the technical pattern, proving the 76% match captured form but not substance

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
